messages.subject: Rhipe not initialising
parts:
Hi,
I installed Rhipe(0.6.5) and protobuf(2.3.0) (as Rhipe was not
installing with protobuf 2.4.1 latest) successfully.
Then tried loading Rhipe in R and then running rhinit(). Got the
following messages. Pls help:

>library(Rhipe)
--------------------------------------------------------
| IMPORTANT: Before using Rhipe call rhinit() |
| Rhipe will not work or most probably crash |
--------------------------------------------------------
Warning message:
In onload.2(libname, pkgname) : HADOOP_BIN is missing, using $HADOOP/
bin

>rhinit()
11/06/28 10:49:50 INFO ipc.Client: Retrying connect to server: /
172.29.178.246:8021. Already tried 0 time(s).

11/06/28 10:49:59 INFO ipc.Client: Retrying connect to server: /
172.29.178.246:8021. Already tried 9 time(s).
Exception in thread "main" java.net.ConnectException: Call to /
172.29.178.246:8021 failed on connection exception:
java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused

Why is this error occuring? And also when I run a command
>rhwrite(list(1,2,3),"/tmp/x")
Error in if (info) { : argument is of length zero
The same occurs for rhread(), rhex() also
Java is 1.6.0.0, OS is Linux Fedora


Pls help me in figuring out the cause for these errors.
